svg.aria-label: Original field-combination and detection schematics. Dashed circles are opposite rotating components; green is their resultant. Equal amplitudes yield a line, unequal amplitudes an ellipse. C shows the functional order of modern modulated detection, connecting Cotton’s optical observation to later photoelectric measurement rather than reconstructing a particular historical device.
